name: 牌組構築BOX 樂園騰龍

description.text: Paradise Dragona Deck Build Box, released on 27 September 2024: ten packs of Paradise Dragona and a fixed 170 cards (9 Pokémon, 59 Trainers, 6 Special Energy and 96 basic Energy), among them Mew ex, Pidgeot ex and ACE SPEC cards, with a card box and four dividers. Some cards differ in look from their first print.

tell.text: An "SVK" mark with an "F" beside it at the bottom left, and a number out of 042
